body:
## Summary

`HeadObject` (`HTTP HEAD /bucket/key`) returns **405 MethodNotAllowed** — HEAD is not in the method match (`crates/gateway-s3/src/lib.rs:344-348`). This breaks the very common HEAD-before-GET/PUT pattern; notably `aws s3 cp` **download** fails (`405 HeadObject`), as do most SDK existence checks.

## Scope for Alpha
- Add a `HEAD` arm to the object dispatch that resolves the key's inode and returns the response **headers only** (no body): `Content-Length`, `ETag`, `Content-Type`, `Last-Modified` — the same metadata `GetObject` returns.
- `404 NoSuchKey` (headers only) when absent.

## Acceptance
- `aws s3api head-object --bucket b --key k` returns size/ETag/Content-Type.
- `aws s3 cp s3://b/k out` (which HEADs first) succeeds.

Depends on: the object-metadata/ETag issue. Part of the 0.1-Alpha S3 completion epic.

milestone.title: 0.1 Alpha
milestone.description: First tagged release (Alpha). Scheduled after the two production-metadata milestones complete: #14 (Metadata Store FoundationDB) and #5 (M4 — Production metadata backend) — i.e. after the FDB go/no-go (#442) records go, the default flips to FDB, and TiKV development stands down (#443). No due date yet; it follows those two. Starts empty as the release marker.
